browser.userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Ubuntu; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) HeadlessChrome/157.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

network.method: A real second browser tab backgrounds the page for 5 seconds; interval callbacks are counted by visibility and the next rendered tick is reconciled against foreground callbacks.

mandelbrot.method: Worker postMessage calls are recorded in the page; hide during deep preset work, confirm explicit cancellation and no new requests, then reactivate and verify a later generation resumes.

caveat: Headless Chromium background-tab behavior does not establish physical-device power use. WEBGL_lose_context checks the WebGL fallback path, not physical GPU failure or WebGPU device-loss behavior.
